title: Support refunds with Claude
summary: Reads a customer's message about their order, has Claude choose refund, decline or escalate, and refunds within the business's rules.

tools.name: handle_refund_request
tools.description: Handle one signed-in customer's refund request about one of their orders: refund up to 100 USD, decline, or pass it to a person.

app_input_requirements.customer: the id of the customer the business's own application has authenticated
app_input_requirements.order: that customer's own order, with the amount they paid, from the business's records

reads: the customer's message and the order the business supplies
sends: the message and the order to the business's model provider
a refund request to the business's payment service
data.retention: nothing is kept by the agent beyond the business's own journals
data.model_training: as the business's agreement with its model provider says; the agent asks for no training use
data.regions: wherever the business's model provider and payment service process data
